description: Daily, point-in-time stock discovery ranks. Candidates are a research watchlist, not trade recommendations or automatic orders.

panels.description: Latest complete cross-sectional rank. The score combines 3/6/12-month momentum, low one-month volatility, and shallow one-month drawdown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT market_session, rank, ticker, sector, candidate, score::double precision AS score, (return_3m * 100)::double precision AS return_3m_pct, (return_6m * 100)::double precision AS return_6m_pct, (return_12m * 100)::double precision AS return_12m_pct, realized_volatility_1m::double precision AS volatility_1m, (max_drawdown_1m * 100)::double precision AS drawdown_1m_pct, eligibility_status FROM discovery_latest_rankings ORDER BY rank NULLS LAST, ticker

panels.title: Latest discovery index

panels.description: Daily score history makes rank stability and deterioration visible. It is not filled across missing discovery sessions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT index.decision_at AS time, ranking.ticker AS metric, ranking.score::double precision AS value FROM discovery_indexes index JOIN discovery_rankings ranking USING (discovery_id) WHERE ranking.eligibility_status = 'eligible' AND $__timeFilter(index.decision_at) ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Discovery score history

panels.description: Retained daily candidates. Repeated appearances indicate ranking persistence; they do not imply an order or position.

targets.rawSql: SELECT index.market_session, index.decision_at, ranking.rank, ranking.ticker, ranking.score::double precision AS score FROM discovery_indexes index JOIN discovery_rankings ranking USING (discovery_id) WHERE ranking.candidate ORDER BY index.market_session DESC, ranking.rank

panels.title: Candidate history
